name: Clear Cart empties the cart and resets the header cart counter to 0
description: After adding products, clicking Clear Cart resets the header cart badge to 0 and the cart summary shows the cart is empty.

planSteps.description: Click Add to Cart on the Aurora Headphones product card
Click Add to Cart on the Ember Smart Mug product card
Click the Clear Cart button in the cart summary panel
Verify the cart counter badge in the page header shows 0
Verify the cart summary panel says the cart is empty and lists no products
